title: NCIS: Facts vs. Fiction
gist: Sailor Pulse episode notes: John Fowler, a retired Naval Criminal Investigative Service senior special agent with 18 years of service, describes a career spanning carrier deployments, human intelligence work in the Middle East, and counterintelligence and counterterrorism cases that rarely surface publicly.

insights.claim: John Fowler retired last year as a senior special agent at the Naval Criminal Investigative Service (NCIS) after 18 years of service.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Context for a practitioner view on naval counterintelligence; low direct market relevance.

themes.theme: Middle East HUMINT and carrier deployments

insights.claim: Fowler's national security career ran on a dual track, from carrier deployments and human intelligence work in the Middle East to counterintelligence and counterterrorism cases.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Illustrates how naval security work integrates HUMINT, counterintelligence and counterterrorism across theaters.

insights.claim: Many NCIS counterintelligence and counterterrorism cases rarely surface publicly, in contrast to the fictional portrayal of the agency.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Public visibility of naval counterintelligence threats understates their actual frequency.
